label: Tags
fromArtist: The artist's tags; change them on its page.

dialog.hint: Several separated by commas. Upper and lower case do not count, as in Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr.

settings.title: Tags
settings.intro: Labels on movies, series and artists, as in Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr. A connection brings its tags along. As there, they decide which indexers a title asks, which download client loads and which waiting time holds.
settings.empty: No tag yet. Set tags on a title's page, or for many at once in the library.
settings.removeText: The tag goes from every movie, series and artist. When it comes from Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr, the next import brings it back.

addHint: Several separated by commas, such as anime, kids

auto.title: Given automatically
auto.intro: Rules that give tags by themselves, as Auto Tagging in Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr. They run over the library right when saved, when a title is added, and every hour.
auto.empty: No rule for this kind yet.
auto.deleteText: What the rule gave stays on the titles, as in the apps. The other rules of this kind run again right away.
auto.applied_one: Saved. The tags of {{count}} title changed.
auto.applied_other: Saved. The tags of {{count}} titles changed.
auto.name: Name
auto.removeHint: When the rule no longer fits, its tags go from the title, even one you set by hand. That is what Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr do.
auto.conditionsHint: Of one kind one fitting condition is enough, different kinds must all fit. “Required” must fit, “Negate” turns the condition round. Quality profile, root folder and monitored fit when one version of the title does.
auto.listHint: Several separated by commas, one of them is enough.

problem.missing: A rule needs a name, at least one tag and at least one condition.
problem.range: From and To are whole numbers.

import.title: Get rules from {{app}}
import.hint: Reads the auto tagging rules of the connection. Nothing is saved until you press “Take over”.
import.none: This connection has no auto tagging rules.
import.noSource: There is no {{app}} connection with a key.
import.done_one: {{count}} rule taken over. Tags changed on {{changed}} entries.
import.done_other: {{count}} rules taken over. Tags changed on {{changed}} entries.
import.exists: A rule of this name is here already; it stays as it is.
import.notTaken: Does not come over, so that it never fits more titles than in the app:
import.removes: Takes its tags off again too, as in the app.

problem.no_tags: None of its tags has a name there.
problem.profile_unknown: There is no quality profile “{{value}}” here.
problem.root_folder_unknown: No version here uses the root folder {{value}}.
problem.language_unknown: The language “{{value}}” cannot be matched here.
problem.status_unknown: The status {{value}} does not exist here.
problem.series_type_unknown: The series type {{value}} does not exist here.
problem.tag_unknown: The tag of the condition has no name there.
problem.condition_unknown: nexcrate does not know the condition {{value}}.
problem.condition_unsupported: The condition {{value}} does not exist here for this kind.
problem.other: Something in it cannot be matched ({{value}}).

dropped.metadata_profile: Taken over without Lidarr's metadata profile, nexcrate has none.
